invented.quote: From September 1, 2027, everyone will work in the office on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.
invented.why: The brief gives the start date as September 1, but does not state the year 2027.

invented.quote: The four of you who live more than two hours from the office can keep working remotely until December 31, 2027, and will come in one day a week from January 2028.
invented.why: The brief says these four employees can work remotely until the end of next year and come in once a week after that, without specifying the years 2027 or 2028.
